# FDM

Fused Deposition Modelling (FDM) builds parts layer-by-layer by extruding thermoplastic filament through a heated nozzle. Wall thickness limits are derived from nozzle diameter at analysis time. Overhang and bridge thresholds depend on material cooling behaviour.

**Process family:** FDM 3D Printing. Wall thickness derived from nozzle diameter. Overhang, bridge, and staircase thresholds from material. Requires print orientation, nozzle diameter, and layer height.

## What you set up

Before it runs, the analysis asks for:

- **Print direction**: which way is up on the printer.
- **Nozzle diameter**: the printer's nozzle. Some values are worked out from it.
- **Layer height**: the slicer's layer height, for the stair-stepping on slopes.

## Rules (15)

Sorted by [criticality](../../concepts/criticality.md). The values are the Default material's; the materials below change some of them.

| Rule | Criticality | Default values | Source |
| :-- | :-- | :-- | :-- |
| [Minimum Wall Thickness](../rules/min-wall-thickness.md) | Critical | Aim for: 1.2 mm · At least: 0.8 mm | Not yet sourced |
| [Maximum Bridge Span](../rules/max-bridge-span.md) | High | Aim for: 15 mm · At most: 40 mm | Not yet sourced |
| [Maximum Overhang Angle](../rules/max-overhang-angle.md) | High | Aim for: 45° · At most: 55° | Not yet sourced |
| [Minimum Gap](../rules/min-print-gap.md) | High | Aim for: 0.5 mm · At least: 0.3 mm | Aim for: Published, [AMF (University of Zurich)](../../citations/bibliography.md#amf-uzh "0.5 mm clearance"), [HLH Prototypes](../../citations/bibliography.md#hlh-fdm)<br>At least: Engineering judgement, [Sovol](../../citations/bibliography.md#sovol-fdm "About the tightest print-in-place gap: 0.2 to 0.3 mm a side (Sovol)") |
| [Maximum Bed Contact Area](../rules/max-bed-contact-area.md) | Medium | Aim for: 5,000 mm² · At most: 10,000 mm² | Not yet sourced |
| [Maximum Support Material](../rules/max-support-material.md) | Medium | Aim for: 15% · At most: 30% | Not yet sourced |
| [Pin Diameter](../rules/min-pin-diameter.md) | Medium | Aim for: 3.0 mm · At least: 2.0 mm | Not yet sourced |
| [Pin Slenderness](../rules/max-pin-slenderness.md) | Medium | Aim for: 10× its diameter · At most: 20× its diameter | Engineering judgement, [Formlabs](../../citations/bibliography.md#formlabs-sla "No source gives an FDM figure; resin prints about 20 diameters (Formlabs)") |
| [Printed Hole Diameter](../rules/min-printed-hole-diameter.md) | Medium | Aim for: 2.0 mm · At least: 1.0 mm | Not yet sourced |
| [Bed Edge Chamfer](../rules/bed-edge-chamfer.md) | Low | If detected: Warning | Published, [UltiMaker](../../citations/bibliography.md#ultimaker-fdm "Chamfer edges on the bed for elephant's foot"), [Hubs](../../citations/bibliography.md#hubs-fdm) |
| [Horizontal Hole Shape](../rules/horizontal-hole-teardrop.md) | Low | If detected: Warning | Not yet sourced |
| [Maximum Cusp Height](../rules/max-cusp-height.md) | Low | Aim for: 0.10 mm · At most: 0.15 mm | Not yet sourced |
| [Pin Root Fillet](../rules/pin-root-fillet.md) | Low | If detected: Warning | Published, [Hubs](../../citations/bibliography.md#hubs-fdm "Pins under 5 mm need a small fillet at the base"), [FacFox](../../citations/bibliography.md#facfox-fdm) |
| [Printed Text](../rules/min-printed-text-depth.md) | Low | Aim for: 0.5 mm · At least: 0.3 mm | Not yet sourced |
| [Printed Text Stroke](../rules/min-printed-text-stroke.md) | Low | Aim for: 0.8 mm · At least: 0.4 mm | Not yet sourced |

## Materials (9)

Each material changes only the values it needs to; everything else comes from the Default material. You can add your own materials in the Process Library.

| Material | Category | Values that differ from Default |
| :-- | :-- | :-- |
| PLA | Standard Thermoplastic | [Maximum Bridge Span](../rules/max-bridge-span.md): Aim for: 20 mm · At most: 50 mm<br>[Maximum Overhang Angle](../rules/max-overhang-angle.md): Aim for: 50° · At most: 60° |
| PLA-CF (Carbon Fiber) | Composite Filament | [Maximum Bridge Span](../rules/max-bridge-span.md): Aim for: 18 mm · At most: 45 mm<br>[Maximum Overhang Angle](../rules/max-overhang-angle.md): Aim for: 48° · At most: 55° |
| PETG | Standard Thermoplastic | [Maximum Bridge Span](../rules/max-bridge-span.md): Aim for: 12 mm · At most: 35 mm<br>[Maximum Overhang Angle](../rules/max-overhang-angle.md): Aim for: 42° · At most: 50° |
| ABS | Engineering Thermoplastic | [Maximum Bed Contact Area](../rules/max-bed-contact-area.md): Aim for: 2,500 mm² · At most: 5,000 mm²<br>[Maximum Bridge Span](../rules/max-bridge-span.md): Aim for: 10 mm · At most: 30 mm<br>[Maximum Overhang Angle](../rules/max-overhang-angle.md): Aim for: 40° · At most: 45° |
| ASA | Engineering Thermoplastic | [Maximum Bed Contact Area](../rules/max-bed-contact-area.md): Aim for: 2,500 mm² · At most: 5,000 mm²<br>[Maximum Bridge Span](../rules/max-bridge-span.md): Aim for: 10 mm · At most: 30 mm<br>[Maximum Overhang Angle](../rules/max-overhang-angle.md): Aim for: 40° · At most: 45° |
| TPU (Flexible) | Flexible Filament | [Maximum Bridge Span](../rules/max-bridge-span.md): Aim for: 8 mm · At most: 20 mm<br>[Maximum Overhang Angle](../rules/max-overhang-angle.md): Aim for: 35° · At most: 40°<br>[Minimum Wall Thickness](../rules/min-wall-thickness.md): Aim for: 1.6 mm · At least: 1.2 mm |
| PA | Engineering Thermoplastic | [Maximum Bed Contact Area](../rules/max-bed-contact-area.md): Aim for: 2,000 mm² · At most: 4,000 mm²<br>[Maximum Bridge Span](../rules/max-bridge-span.md): Aim for: 10 mm · At most: 30 mm<br>[Maximum Overhang Angle](../rules/max-overhang-angle.md): Aim for: 38° · At most: 45° |
| PA-CF (Carbon Fiber) | Composite Filament | [Maximum Bridge Span](../rules/max-bridge-span.md): Aim for: 15 mm · At most: 40 mm<br>[Maximum Overhang Angle](../rules/max-overhang-angle.md): Aim for: 42° · At most: 50° |
| PC | Engineering Thermoplastic | [Maximum Bed Contact Area](../rules/max-bed-contact-area.md): Aim for: 2,000 mm² · At most: 4,000 mm²<br>[Maximum Bridge Span](../rules/max-bridge-span.md): Aim for: 10 mm · At most: 30 mm<br>[Maximum Overhang Angle](../rules/max-overhang-angle.md): Aim for: 38° · At most: 45° |
